info.name: TaskHive - Audit Module
info.description:
Complete testing collection for the Audit module (Phase 5).

**Pre-requisites:**
1. Auth, Employee, and Task modules must be set up and running.
2. Admin user must exist (admin@taskhive.com / Admin@123).
3. At least one employee and task should exist to generate audit trail data.

**Flow:**
1. Login as Admin (cookies set automatically)
2. Trigger audit events (create employee, create/update task)
3. GET /audit/logs — paginated audit log listing
4. GET /audit/logs/search — filtered search with date range, action, entity type
5. GET /audit/logs/entity/{type}/{id} — entity-specific timeline
6. GET /audit/security-events — security event listing
7. GET /audit/compliance/report — compliance reports (JSON + CSV)
8. Negative tests — employee access denied, invalid params

**Note:** Audit logs are created automatically via event listeners. Security events (LOGIN_FAILED, ACCOUNT_LOCKED, UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS) are logged directly by AuthService and GlobalExceptionHandler.
